title: Oven Roasted Spanish Pork Jamon Iberico
description: A tangy and aerated Spanish dish featuring shredded coconut and Jamon Iberico, cooked in a terracotta dish. This recipe is anti-inflammatory friendly and has a cozy Catalan twist.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Rub the spice mixture all over the Jamon Iberico slices.
Heat the olive oil in a terracotta dish over medium heat.
Add the Jamon Iberico slices to the terracotta dish and sear for 2 minutes on each side.
Transfer the terracotta dish to the preheated oven and roast for 15 minutes.
While the Jamon Iberico is roasting, mix together shredded coconut and lemon juice in a small bowl.
After 15 minutes, remove the terracotta dish from the oven and top the Jamon Iberico with the coconut mixture.
Return the terracotta dish to the oven and roast for an additional 5 minutes.
